selection: Thirteen published flat-rate price paths at eight providers plus two interchange-plus rate cards; not a market-wide sample or an overall service ranking.
scope: Standard published online card pricing for a US business; custom, volume and enterprise contracts, in-person rates, bank debits, wallets priced differently, buy-now-pay-later and platform (Connect-style) pricing are excluded.

methodology.evidence: Public provider pricing pages and documentation; no live transactions, statements or merchant data.
methodology.money_unit: integer USD cents; percentages stored as decimal strings and evaluated as exact fractions
methodology.processing_fee_lost_on_full_refund: domestic fee where the provider states that the original processing fee is not returned; null where not stated
methodology.rounding: Cents are rounded half up from exact fractions for display and export; effective rates are shown to two decimal places.
excluded: ACH, bank transfer and wallet-specific rates
network, scheme and premium-card pass-through fees
platform subscriptions other than the listed monthly fees
chargeback outcomes beyond the published fee
sales tax or VAT collected by merchant-of-record services
methodology.rebuild_policy: Rebuilding does not refresh observation dates. Verify current pricing before creating a new edition.
methodology.retrieval: Pages were retrieved from a US network location on September 14, 2026 (UTC); several providers serve region-specific prices to other locations.

sources.title: Stripe US pricing
sources.supports: 2.9% + $0.30 per successful domestic card transaction; +1.5% international cards; +1% currency conversion; $15 dispute received fee and $15 dispute countered fee; refunds free for cards; processing and conversion fees not returned on refunds; no setup or monthly fees; Managed Payments adds 3.5%.

sources.title: Stripe — How disputes work
sources.supports: The dispute received fee is non-refundable outside Mexico; the dispute countered fee is returned on a win.

sources.title: Stripe — Refund and cancel payments
sources.supports: Stripe's processing fees from the original transaction aren't returned on a refund.

sources.title: PayPal US merchant fees (last updated September 1, 2026)
sources.supports: PayPal Checkout, Venmo and guest checkout 3.49% + $0.49; Standard Credit and Debit Card Payments 2.99% + $0.49; Advanced Credit and Debit Card Payments 2.89% + $0.29; +1.50% on international commercial transactions; 3.00% currency conversion spread on received funds; $20 chargeback fee for card chargebacks outside a PayPal account; $15 standard and $30 high-volume dispute fee; fees paid to receive a payment are not returned on refund.

sources.title: PayPal — When is the dispute fee applied and how is it calculated?
sources.supports: If a seller appeals and wins, the disputed amount and the Standard Dispute Fee are reimbursed; the High Volume Dispute Fee is not.

sources.title: PayPal Braintree fees (last updated May 7, 2026)
sources.supports: 2.89% + $0.29 for cards and digital wallets; additional 1% for cards issued outside the US and 1% for non-USD transactions; $15 chargeback fee; transaction fees are not returned for refunded transactions.

sources.title: Shopify US pricing
sources.supports: US view: Basic $39/month ($29 on yearly billing), Grow $105 ($79), Advanced $399 ($299); Shopify Payments online standard card rates 2.9%, 2.7% and 2.5% + 30¢, online premium card rates 3.5%, 3.3% and 3.1% + 30¢, online international rates +1%; third-party transaction fees 2%, 1% and 0.6%. The page serves local-currency views by visitor location.

sources.title: Shopify — Domestic, international and EEA credit cards
sources.supports: US stores using Shopify Payments pay a 1% cross-border fee on sales with cards issued in another country.

sources.title: Shopify — Fees and costs for international selling
sources.supports: 1.5% currency conversion fee for US stores (2% elsewhere); conversion and card fees are not returned on refunds; no extra conversion fee on refunds or chargebacks.

sources.title: Shopify Payments — Refunds
sources.supports: The original credit card transaction fee is not refunded; no additional fee is charged for processing a refund.

sources.title: Shopify Payments — Chargeback process and country fees
sources.supports: US chargeback fee $15, returned on a win.

sources.title: Authorize.net pricing
sources.supports: All-in-One option $25 per month and 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction; gateway-only option $25 per month and 10¢ per transaction plus a 10¢ daily batch fee; $0.00 gateway chargeback fee for cards and $25 for eCheck.Net chargebacks. No international surcharge or refund-fee policy is quantified on the page.

sources.title: Paddle pricing
sources.supports: 5% + 50¢ per Checkout transaction as merchant of record, no monthly fees; custom pricing for products under $10 or invoicing.

sources.title: Paddle — Understanding chargebacks
sources.supports: Chargeback fee 20 USD/GBP/EUR or 40 CAD/AUD; not refunded when Paddle wins the dispute.

sources.title: Lemon Squeezy — Fees
sources.supports: 5% + 50¢ per transaction; +1.5% for transactions outside the US; +1.5% for PayPal; +0.5% for subscription payments; payouts via Stripe are free to US bank accounts.

sources.title: Lemon Squeezy — Refunds and chargebacks
sources.supports: Refunded amount minus the platform fee is deducted from the next payout; chargebacks deduct the refunded amount minus the platform fee plus a $15 dispute fee.

sources.title: Lemon Squeezy — Currencies
sources.supports: Transactions are processed in USD at mid-market rates with no additional conversion fee.

sources.title: Adyen pricing
sources.supports: $0.13 fixed processing fee per transaction plus Interchange++ and a 0.60% markup for Visa and Mastercard in North America; no monthly or setup fees, but a minimum invoice depending on industry.

sources.title: Square pricing (US)
sources.supports: Square Free: online or invoice card payments 3.3% + 30¢, Online API 2.9% + 30¢, tap/dip/swipe 2.6% + 15¢, manually entered or card on file 3.5% + 15¢; Square Plus and Premium: online 2.9% + 30¢; international card transaction fee 1.5% on every plan.

sources.title: Square — Learn about Square fees
sources.supports: Same rate table by plan; 1.5% international transaction fee for cards issued in a different country than the Square account, on all tiers; no fees for chargebacks and dispute management.

sources.title: Square — Manage customer refunds
sources.supports: When you refund a payment, the processing fees for the payment aren't refunded back to you.

sources.title: Square — Payment disputes walkthrough
sources.supports: No dispute-management fees for chargebacks; the disputed amount is held and returned on a win.

sources.title: Helcim pricing
sources.supports: Interchange+ 0.50% + 25¢ for keyed and online payments and 0.40% + 8¢ in person at $0–50K monthly card volume, falling with volume; $0 chargeback fee for cases resolved in your favor and $15 if lost; no added fee for refunds but processing fees remain payable; no monthly, signup or PCI fees; recurring payments add 0.4%.

providers.name: Stripe
providers.note: Standard pay-as-you-go pricing. Managed Payments (merchant of record) adds 3.5% and is excluded.

providers.name: PayPal Checkout (PayPal, Venmo, guest)
providers.note: Currency conversion is a 3.00% spread on received funds; a 4.00% spread applies to buyer-side conversion.

providers.name: PayPal Standard Credit and Debit Card Payments
providers.note: Card chargebacks filed with the issuer outside a PayPal account carry the chargeback fee.

providers.name: PayPal Advanced Credit and Debit Card Payments
PayPal Braintree
providers.note: Monthly fee not stated on the fee page.

providers.name: Square Free — online checkout or invoice
providers.note: Square Plus and Premium plans list 2.9% + 30¢ online with a monthly subscription. US accounts settle in USD; no conversion fee is published.

providers.name: Square Free — Online API
providers.note: Card payments made inside a web or mobile app through Square payments APIs.

providers.name: Authorize.net All-in-One
providers.note: Bundled gateway and merchant account. International surcharge and refund-fee treatment are not quantified on the pricing page.

providers.name: Paddle
providers.note: Merchant of record: tax registration, filing and remittance are included. No separate international or conversion surcharge is published; refund-fee treatment was not stated on the pages retrieved.

providers.name: Lemon Squeezy
providers.note: Merchant of record. PayPal payments add 1.5% and subscription payments add 0.5%; transactions are processed in USD without a conversion fee.
